title: Our Place
description: Winner, Best Song at the San Diego Short Film Festival's Q3 showcase: a devious romance emerges in the midst of a tragic breakup, written and directed by Jacob Willett. A queer satire with a fully custom-composed score performed by real session musicians on live brass, organ, piano, and clarinet, inspired by John Waters and Divine's "Female Trouble" — the lead actress came into the studio to record vocals.
